name: What is the difference between crown molding and other trim types like baseboards or casing?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between crown molding and other trim types like baseboards or casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crown molding specifically refers to the decorative trim installed at the junction where walls meet the ceiling. Baseboards are trim pieces installed at the bottom of walls where they meet the floor, protecting the wall and concealing gaps. Casing is the trim used around door and window frames to cover the gap between the frame and the wall. Each serves a distinct aesthetic and functional purpose, but together they contribute to a cohesive interior design. Understanding these distinctions helps in planning a comprehensive trim package.
acceptedAnswer.description: Crown molding is ceiling-wall trim, baseboards are floor-wall trim, and casing is trim around doors and windows. Each has a distinct purpose.
